QuestInfo.name: The Return
QuestInfo.0: Follow Tumbleweed's suggestion and ask #bCartalion#k in #bPantheon#k about the Interdimensional Portal.
QuestInfo.1: The #bInterdimensional Portal#k to Maple World is #bin the Great Temple#k. Head inside the Great Temple.
QuestInfo.2: After leaving Fox Point Village, reached a strange city called Pantheon. Inside the Great Temple, you find portal that links Grandis to Maple World.
